heading: Interpretative guidelines and exemptions
lead: The Director of the Office of Management and Budget may—

tree.text: issue supplementary interpretative guidelines to promote consistent and efficient use of procurement contracts, grant agreements, and cooperative agreements; and
exempt a transaction or program of an executive agency from this chapter.
